title: Seedling
description:
Every farm has to start somewhere. Obtain your first seeds or plantable root vegetable.

You can break grass to find Wheat Seeds, or explore to find patches of vegetables growing in the wild.

Cabbages and Beetroot can be found on Beaches.

Potatoes can be found in cold biomes.

Onions and Carrots can be found in temperate biomes.

Tomatoes are found in arid biomes.

And Rice can be found in Swamps and Jungles.

If you need help finding a particular biome, you can craft a Nature's Compass to point you in the right direction.
